title: audit-scrap-heuristics-amira-2026
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratch of heuristics and lightweight mapping for SOC2 prep. Keep this as a living cheat-sheet — not final, but close enough to hand to SEs and Eng leads when they ask for evidence.

Top-level risks I'm thinking about (raw):
- Data exfil from hosted API keys (key leakage, logs contain tokens)
- Misconfigured private deployments exposing internal networks
- Incomplete change control for model/serving runtime updates (latent regressions)
- Insufficient user access reviews for Admin/Customer Support consoles

Controls & evidence heuristics (raw mapping):
1) Access provisioning / deprovisioning
   - Evidence: SCIM provisioning logs, Okta app assignments export (CSV), most recent offboarding ticket list (JIRA-OPS), last 12 months access review doc.
   - Quick ask to Eng: export last 6 months of Okta audit entries for user lifecycle.

2) Key management (hosted & private)
   - Evidence: KMS key rotation schedule, HSM access logs (if used), KMS policy JSON, PRs that changed key policies.
   - Note: private deployments may use customer-managed keys — request attestation template from Solutions Eng.

3) Change control for infra and runtime
   - Evidence: GH PRs with the tag 'serving-runtime-deploy', deployment runbooks, canary rollouts records (console logs), rollback incidents.
   - Heuristic: any model change that touches kernel selection / quantization must have an eval artifact + rollout plan.

4) Logging & monitoring (detection)
   - Evidence: ELK/Datadog retention config, alert runbooks, incident timelines (pagerduty IDs).

5) Data handling (customer data & telemetry)
   - Evidence: dataflow diagrams, data classification spreadsheet, telemetry scrub tools config (s3://redwood-internal/telemetry-redact).

Unresolved questions / TODOs (short):
- [ ] Confirm retention policy for request logs for hosted API (current answer from infra: 90d?). ACTION: ask Priya (infra logging).
- [ ] Get a sample of “redacted” debug dump from a private deployment to verify PII removal pattern. OWNER: Diego.
- [ ] Draft a short template the Solutions team can use to produce "customer attestation" for KMS-managed private deployments. OWNER: Riley.

Quick interview prompts for Eng leads (use in 15-min syncs):
- What change process did you follow for the last model version swap? Link PR and rollout doc.
- Show me where the model-serving config is stored and who can merge to that repo.
- How are API keys rotated and are there automated key revocation workflows?

Evidence collection mini-plan (pragmatic):
- Phase 0 (this week): gather existing artifacts (okta export, KMS policy, 3 recent deploy PRs) -> drop into shared folder.
- Phase 1 (next 2 weeks): assemble short narratives per control (2-paragraph each) with 1–2 artifacts attached.
- Phase 2 (end of month): internal dry-run walkthrough with CS and Solutions Eng (20–30 min).

Notes-to-self: keep artifacts lightweight; auditors want reproducible trails not perfect prose. Favor logs + PRs + runbooks. Always annotate artifacts with: why this proves the control, and who to ping if questions.

References & fragments to copy to Confluence later:
- "Control: Change Control for Model Serving" — bullet list + required artifacts
- Template: Evidence submission checklist (artifact link, short narrative, owner, date)

End of page — subjective heuristics. Will prune and formalize after dry run.
